description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402] Computes public holidays from the rules in law instead of memory: US federal holidays (fixed dates moved to Friday/Monday when they fall on a weekend, nth-weekday holidays such as Thanksgiving, Juneteenth from 2021) or bank holidays in England and Wales (Easter-based, substitute days for weekends, Christmas/Boxing Day combinations, and the one-off royal holidays proclaimed so far). For each: name, the calendar date, the observed day off and weekday. Also returns the observed dates as a list ready for business_days or date_series. Up to 10 years per call. Future one-off holidays are only included once proclaimed.

country.description: US = United States federal; GB-EAW = England and Wales bank holidays
